options.content: Optimizer objective, contribution fractions, timing, and gradient health.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final','best']) AS stage
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','contribution_fractions'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric,
       CASE WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0 ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','gradients'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY 1
